Container.Name: VehicleVault
Container.Overview:
VehicleVault is a modern, privacy-first, self-hosted vehicle lifecycle, fuel, maintenance, digital glovebox, and TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) platform. Built with a responsive React PWA, Node.js TypeScript API, Tesseract OCR receipt scanner, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI assistants.
[b]Key Features:[/b] - [b]Fleet & Garage Management:[/b] Multi-vehicle profiles (cars, motorcycles, trailers, vans) with cover photos, specifications, and telemetry. - [b]Dutch RDW Open Data:[/b] 1-click license plate autofill and automated background APK expiry monitoring with alert notifications. - [b]Quick-Log Fueling & OCR Scanner:[/b] Fast mobile PWA fueling interface with built-in Tesseract OCR for automatic receipt parsing (liters, €/L, total cost). - [b]Digital Glovebox & Documents:[/b] Secure vault for registrations, insurance green cards, APK reports, garage invoices, and user manuals with category filters. - [b]Dual-Trigger Maintenance Engine:[/b] Track distance and time service intervals with parts vs. labor cost split and DIY savings indicator. - [b]Dynamic TCO & Tank Analytics:[/b] Operational vs. asset TCO with purchase price toggle, tank range metrics, fuel price evolution, and gas station comparisons. - [b]Digital Service Dossier:[/b] Generate downloadable, clean PDF service booklets suitable for vehicle sales or insurance archives. - [b]Offline Mode & PWA:[/b] Offline caching with an offline fuel queue that automatically synchronizes when connectivity is restored. - [b]AI Integration (MCP):[/b] Built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Claude Desktop, Antigravity, and AI agents via stdio or authenticated HTTP/SSE. - [b]Multi-Language:[/b] Full Dutch (NL) and English (EN) interface switchable in settings.
[b]Initial Setup:[/b] Open the web interface at [inline]http://[IP]:[PORT:3001]/[/inline]. The first user registered will automatically be granted Administrator privileges.

Container.Changes:
### v1.0.9 (2026-10-28) - Google Gemini 2.0 Flash migratie: Standaard Gemini model bijgewerkt naar gemini-2.0-flash ter vervanging van verouderde 1.5-flash endpoints. - Automatische Fallback & Self-Healing AI: Intelligente cascading endpoint fallback (v1beta -> v1 -> gemini-2.0-flash -> dynamische modelherkenning) zodat 404-fouten automatisch worden opgevangen en de werkende configuratie direct wordt opgeslagen. - DOM Form Fix: Wachtwoordveld in Instellingen gewrapt in een form-element om Chrome console warnings te verhelpen.
### v1.0.8 (2026-10-28) - Tankbeurten Bewerken: Potlood-icoon (Bewerken) toegevoegd aan de tabel Recente Tankbeurten onder Acties. Hiermee kunnen datum, kilometerstand, liters, literprijs, totaalbedrag, tankstation, adres, notities en gekoppelde bonnen/facturen achteraf worden gewijzigd. - Backend PUT /api/fuel/:id endpoint toegevoegd met eigendomscontrole en automatische total-cost herberekening.
### v1.0.7 (2026-10-28) - PWA WebAPK Installatie Fix: Echte raster PNG iconen (192x192, 512x512, maskable en apple-touch-icon) toegevoegd aan manifest.json ter vervanging van SVG, waarmee Android WebAPK installatie foutloos slaagt. - Mobiele Web App Meta Tags: Ondersteuning voor iOS Safari en Android standalone weergave. - Service Worker Caching: Geoptimaliseerde en tolerante prefetching van PWA-bestanden.
### v1.0.6 (2026-10-28) - Google Gemini Authorization Key Fix: Ondersteuning voor nieuwste Google AI Studio API-sleutels (AQ. prefix) via x-goog-api-key header en Bearer fallback. - Sleutelbehoud bij Opslaan: Voorkomt per ongeluk wissen van de opgeslagen AI API-sleutel wanneer instellingen worden opgeslagen. - Sleutel Wissen Knop: Mogelijkheid om opgeslagen sleutels expliciet te verwijderen via Instellingen. - Transparante AI Status: Bon-scanner toont direct actieve engine en eventuele AI-foutmeldingen.
### v1.0.5 (2026-10-28) - Tankstation & Adres Registratie: Optioneel vastleggen van tankstationnaam en straatadres bij elke tankbeurt. - Dynamische GPS Tankstation Finder: Mobiele PWA GPS-integratie om via OpenStreetMap direct de dichtstbijzijnde tankstations binnen handbereik te tonen gesorteerd op afstand (bijv. 120 m). - Slimme Tankstation Zoekbalk: Dynamisch zoeken naar tankstations op naam, merk of plaats (bijv. Fieten Steenwijk, Shell A28). - AI & Kaart Integratie: AI Vision vult automatisch het adres in, met directe doorklikbare Google Maps links op geregistreerde tankbeurten.
### v1.0.4 (2026-10-28) - AI Vision Bonherkenning: Koppel Google Gemini (1.5/2.0 Flash) of OpenAI (GPT-4o-mini) voor 100% accurate bonextractie van dot-matrix thermische tankbonnen (inclusief tankstation, datum, liters, literprijs en brandstoftype). - Automatische fallback naar lokale Tesseract OCR indien geen AI-sleutel ingesteld is. - Instellingencentrum uitgebreid met interactieve AI-verbindingstests en beveiligde opslag van API-sleutels. - Layoutoptimalisatie van bon-scanner modal (geen clipping of overflow meer). - Automatisch vullen van notities met gedetecteerd tankstation en brandstofmerk.
### v1.0.3 (2026-10-28) - Added manual receipt and invoice upload for fuel fill-ups. - Added fuel price statistics: weighted average price, cheapest and most expensive fill-up, and interactive price evolution chart. - Added Dutch fuel economy notation (e.g. "1 op 18.5") across Dashboard, Fuel Log, and Analytics. - Fixed Dashboard recent fuel activity endpoint and live refresh. - Enhanced PDF dossier export with fuel receipt thumbnails and clean styling. - Dynamically synchronized application version string across all components.
### v1.0.0 (2026-10-28) - Initial release of VehicleVault. - Fleet management with RDW open data integration and APK status alerts. - Tesseract OCR receipt scanner for fuel fill-ups. - Digital glovebox document repository for registrations, insurance, APK reports, and invoices. - Dual-trigger maintenance intervals with parts and labor cost split and DIY savings tracking. - Dynamic TCO engine, tank range analytics, and PDF service booklet export. - Offline PWA caching with background synchronization queue. - Model Context Protocol (MCP) server support for AI agents. - Bilingual interface (Dutch and English).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The port for the VehicleVault web interface (internal container port is 3001).

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Storage path for SQLite database (vehiclevault.db), uploaded vehicle photos, receipt scans, documents, and invoices.

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: Secret key used to sign access tokens (JWT). Leave blank for auto-generated default, or generate a random 32-character string.

Config.Name: JWT Refresh Secret
Config.Description: Secret key used to sign refresh tokens. Leave blank for auto-generated default, or generate a random 32-character string.

Config.Name: Gemini API Key
Config.Description: Optional Google Gemini API key for high-speed AI fuel receipt scanning.

Config.Name: OpenAI API Key
Config.Description: Optional OpenAI API key for GPT-4o-mini receipt scanning.
